guide.label: Simulation steps
guide.skip: Use typical values and see results

questions.employees: How many people work in your organisation?
questions.salary: What does an average employee cost per year?
questions.turnover: How many people leave each year?
questions.programme: What kind of coaching are you considering?
questions.engagement: How engaged are your people today?
questions.absence: How many days is a person absent per year?
questions.replacePct: What does replacing one leaver cost?

questionNotes.employees: Count everyone on payroll who could be in scope.
questionNotes.salary: Use the loaded cost: salary plus social charges and benefits.
questionNotes.turnover: Your yearly staff turnover rate, all reasons.
questionNotes.programme: Pick the closest match. We size reach and cost from it.
questionNotes.investment: Fees per participant and how long the programme runs.
questionNotes.engagement: Share of people rated highly engaged in your last survey.
questionNotes.absence: Average sick and absence days per person, per year.
questionNotes.replacePct: Recruiting, onboarding and lost output, as a share of salary.

hints.label: What this means:
hints.employees: About {participants} people would take part in a {programme} programme.
hints.salary: One working day costs you about {dayRate}.
hints.turnover: About {leavers} people leave your organisation each year.
hints.programme: {participants} people are coached directly, {eff} in weighted reach including colleagues around them.
hints.engagement: Lower scores leave more room for coaching to make a difference. Strong coaching cultures report 62% highly engaged.
hints.absence: That's about {total} absence days a year across your organisation.
hints.replacePct: Replacing one leaver costs you about {cost}.
